title: Self Treat vs Seek Help
description: Starts with the emergencies that need 911 now, including BE FAST stroke signs, heart attack, anaphylaxis, severe bleeding, and sepsis, then explains which wounds, burns, sprains, fevers, and stomach illnesses you can manage yourself, gray-zone problems, and what to do when help is far away.
shortDescription: Call-911 red flags like BE FAST and heart attack, and what you can manage
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
